sponsors.title: SpaceXAI
sponsors.text: We're always looking for exceptional engineers for SpaceXAI!

sponsors.title: Amazon
sponsors.text: We're Annapurna Labs! We build Amazon's custom chips: Graviton (the processors running AWS), Trainium and Inferentia (the silicon behind AI training and inference). We design the hardware. We write the compilers. We make models run fast on silicon we built from scratch. We're basically like a chip startup that doesn't have to fundraise.. :) If you like building things at the lowest level, come find us. We're hiring interns and new grads and we move fast.

sponsors.title: Dominion Dynamics
sponsors.text:
Dominion Dynamics is building intelligent systems for extreme operations: integrated autonomy, sensing, communications, and command and control capabilities for defence, security, and critical infrastructure.

Backed by some of the world’s best investors, our team includes veterans of Anduril, Amazon, Tesla, and the Canadian Armed Forces, combining Silicon Valley speed with Waterloo-grade engineering and a deep national-security focus.

If you're driven by the opportunity to solve complex problems, build something real, and change the country, this is where you belong.

sponsors.title: Federato
sponsors.text: Federato is on a mission to help insurers deliver efficient, equitable, and affordable coverage in a rapidly changing world shaped by climate risk, cyber threats, and social inflation. As the only AI-native platform spanning the full policy lifecycle, Federato transforms how insurance work gets done by embedding better decision-making directly into underwriting workflows. Insurers can align portfolio goals, business strategies, rules, and risk appetite within a single system, enabling underwriters to identify and win the right opportunities faster. From submission intake to portfolio management, AI prioritizes high-appetite business, delivers real-time insights, streamlines workflows, and helps insurers achieve stronger, more profitable outcomes.

sponsors.title: RBC
sponsors.text: Students and new grads are an important part of building our future, and central to our purpose to help clients thrive and communities prosper. With hundreds of roles, across dozens of work streams, students and new grads have countless opportunities to learn, grow, and work with purpose across multiple environments and technologies. We’re focused on helping motivate and encourage the next generation of brilliant minds to grow their skills, make an impact, and Be What’s Next.

sponsors.title: Cursor
sponsors.text:
Cursor is the best way to build software with AI. It knows your codebase, writes with you, and handles the tedious parts so you can stay in flow and focus on the idea you came here to build. 

This weekend, every hacker gets $50 in Cursor credits. Use them to move fast: scaffold features, fix bugs, and ship a demo you're proud of.

Bring your best idea. We'll help you build it. Claim your $50 and start building!

sponsors.title: Shenzhen D-Robotics Co., Ltd.
sponsors.text:
Greetings to all hackathon participants from D Robotics.
We are a robotics development infra provider, building RDK AI developer kits to empower global embodied robotics innovators. Honored to sponsor this event. Beyond this hackathon, take part in our Robotics Dream Keeper Challenge, a dedicated builder journey. We sincerely invite you to join our global developer community. Connect with fellow makers, gain technical resources, showcase your projects and keep innovating AI robotics together. Enjoy your building experience. We look forward to your creative works and welcoming you in community!

sponsors.title: Citadel
sponsors.text: Citadel is a multi-strategy alternative investment manager. For more than three decades, we’ve captured undiscovered market opportunities by empowering extraordinary people to pursue their best and boldest ideas. Each day at Citadel, we reimagine and refine our strategies, models and technology in pursuit of superior long-term performance. Citadel Securities is the next-generation capital markets firm. We create efficient ways for buyers and sellers to come together; we innovative ways to price and absorb risk; and we develop new technologies to transform markets. Integrating deep financial, mathematical and engineering expertise, Citadel Securities delivers critical liquidity to central banks, financial institutions, government agencies, corporations, insurers and sovereign wealth funds.

sponsors.title: Composio
sponsors.text: Want an on-the-spot interview with one of SF's fastest-growing AI startups? Complete our online assessment for a chance to interview with us live at Hack the North! We're hiring for both intern and new-grad roles across full-stack and forward-deployed engineering. Composio builds the infrastructure that lets AI agents take action. We raised a $25M Series A from Lightspeed, 3x'd our ARR this year, and ship for customers like Google, AWS, Mercor, Mintlify, and Emergent. You'll own real product surfaces and learn fast on a lean team that ships daily. The perks: $10K USD/month, visa sponsorship, free food, and an incredible team in the heart of San Francisco. Give it a shot at https://apply.litmushiring.com/composio/hack-the-north!

sponsors.title: Cybernetic Labs
sponsors.text:
Netic aims to build the autonomous enterprise. We are a small but mighty team of 50 builders who obsess over making sure AI works in the real world. We started in home services, but have since expanded to 10+ industries, rolling out end-to-end agentic AI that directly generates revenue for our customers.

Netic is a Series B company based in SF, backed by Founders Fund, Greylock, and Hanabi Capital. 

We are hiring early-career customer, product, and agent engineers who want to take on outsized ownership. You'll build AI agents and ship directly into live customer deployments. Apply if you'd like to join us!

sponsors.title: GPTZero
sponsors.text:
Hey hackers! 

You're about to embark on something special. I remember when I went to my first HTN and demoing on stage as a finalist in 2017. It was just as valuable as hacking as meeting the amazing humans around me, 

We challenge you to see how we can cherish our humanity in an age where we spending more and more time talking to machines. Excited to meet you there!

sponsors.title: Google
sponsors.text: Make your application for your future position at Google easier than ever by filling out your Google Careers profile. Please fill out this short form to be informed about all future applications, events, scholarships, and other Google programs! The information you submit will be used in accordance with Google's Candidate Privacy Policy: https://careers.google.com/privacy-policy/. If you wish to request the deletion of your RSVP form, please send an email to hrdatarequest@google.com.

sponsors.title: Hudson River Trading
sponsors.text: Hudson River Trading (HRT) is a leading quantitative trading firm at the forefront of technical innovation in global financial markets. Every day, we bring together the world’s sharpest minds to collaboratively solve challenging problems and design the technology that will drive the future of trading. Leveraging one of the world’s most sophisticated computing environments for quantitative research and development, we trade across multiple time horizons and asset classes on more than 200 markets worldwide from our global offices. We are a leading voice for fair and transparent markets everywhere and dedicated to creating a better trading landscape for all.

sponsors.title: Intact
sponsors.text:
At Intact, insurance is not about things. It’s about people.  
From coast to coast, one in five Canadians count on Intact to protect what matters most to them.  As the largest provider of property and casualty (P&C) insurance in Canada and a leading provider of specialty insurance in North America, they are steering the industry towards an exciting future. 
Along with the advances Intact is making with insurance technology and digital tools, they’re building partnerships that are defining:  the future of transportation; how we use big data; how people interact with their homes, cars and environment; and how to be collaborative consumers within the sharing economy.

sponsors.title: Logitech
sponsors.text:
Precision. Performance. Mastery.

Introducing The Master Series by Logitech, a range of products that unleash your capability to create, make, and do. Master your next project with tools that transform the way you work – from revolutionizing your creative process to helping you focus and get in your flow. 

Interested in creating your own custom plugins for Logitech MX devices? This link will give you all the software tools you need, along with information on how to upload your plugins to the Logi Marketplace reaching thousands of Logitech users worldwide.

sponsors.title: OMEN ANALYTICS INC
sponsors.text: Omen AI builds custom sensors and AI models to monitor the fluid health of infrastructure for the industrial and data center market.

sponsors.title: QNX
sponsors.text: QNX is home-grown Canadian tech, and it drives (sometimes literally) much of the embedded compute world around you. If you want to work in (and build things in) med tech, industrial automation, automotive, robotics, physical AI, green energy tech, and more, check out the QNX Everywhere program to try QNX today!

sponsors.title: Rilla
sponsors.text:
Our mission: In 1998, Google indexed the world's online information, fundamentally changing our lives. 95% of commerce still happens offline. In stores, offices, and homes. The backbone of our economy has been virtually untouched by Silicon Valley. We're on a mission to change that.

The Rilla team combines expertise from top tech companies and institutions, including former founders, professionals, and D1 Athletes, to create the next-generation conversation intelligence platform.

sponsors.title: Rox
sponsors.text:
At Rox we're all in on the new way to build an AI-native engineering team: Alpha comes from early-career people who aren’t stuck in how things have always been done. They think from scratch, build AI-native, and have such high slope they end up leading products & teams. 

Who wants to join in the high-stakes talent engineering game?

sponsors.title: Rundoo Inc
sponsors.text:
Not every engineer wants this much ownership.

Rundoo is going after a massive, untapped market, and we're just getting started. Building materials is a $1 trillion industry still running on decades-old, on-premise software. We're building the AI-first operating system for independent suppliers: the hardware stores, paint shops, and flooring suppliers overlooked by modern tech. Think Shopify, but for the trades.

Here you own the whole problem: talk to the store owner, build the fix, ship it now, and stay relentless until it lands. No layers, no handoffs.

We're early, moving fast, and we hire from Waterloo. Come build something from the ground up.

sponsors.title: Sentry
sponsors.text:
Sentry is the application monitoring platform built for developers who care about code quality. Trusted by hundreds of thousands of engineering teams worldwide, Sentry gives you full visibility into errors, performance bottlenecks, and crashes across every layer of your stack, frontend, backend, and mobile.

With Sentry's AI-powered debugging tool, Seer, you don't just see what broke, you get intelligent suggestions to fix it faster. From error monitoring and distributed tracing to session replay and log management, Sentry brings everything into one place so your team can ship with confidence.

Stop guessing. Start fixing. Try Sentry free at sentry.io.

sponsors.title: Solana
sponsors.text: Solana is the fastest and most used blockchain in the world — processing more transactions and generating more on-chain revenue than all other chains combined. With a vibrant developer community and abundant developer resources, Solana is the go-to network for blockchain app development.

sponsors.title: Sun Life
sponsors.text:
Why students choose Sun Life
Whether you're interested in technology, data, AI, communications, marketing, business, or client experience, Sun Life offers opportunities to explore different career paths while building practical skills in a supportive environment.
Students can contribute to meaningful work that supports Sun Life’s purpose of helping Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives.
Students at Sun Life can:
•	Gain hands-on experience working on real projects
•	Connect with mentors and professionals across the organization
•	Build their network through coffee chats and collaborative events
•	Access learning and development opportunities
•	Explore a wide variety of career paths and disciplines
•	Contribute to meaningful work that supports real teams, clients, and communities

sponsors.title: TD
sponsors.text:
We're excited to share that TD co-op/ Intern opportunities will soon be available for application (Sept 8- 25)!
To learn more about our co-op programs, teams, and career paths, we encourage you to explore the TD Careers website. It's a great way to discover the types of roles available, gain insight into life at TD, and find opportunities that align with your interests and career goals.
Be sure to review the available postings and apply to roles that match your skills and aspirations. We look forward to seeing your applications and welcoming the next generation of talent to TD.

sponsors.title: Tether
sponsors.text:
Tether helped redefine global finance. Now we're building the next layer: open, resilient systems for finance, AI, energy and communication.
No gatekeepers. No Big Tech control. Just powerful infrastructure for developers to build what comes next.

The next era of software isn’t happening in giant server farms - it’s happening on-device and peer-to-peer. We’re hiring the hackers who want to build decentralized networks, local AI, and truly sovereign tech.

Skip the standard internship grind. Come build the future of the internet with us.

sponsors.title: Virtu Financial
sponsors.text: At Virtu, leadership comes from anyone. We believe the key to our success is giving our teams the opportunity to make a difference each day they’re here.
